curl -sfL -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" -o /tmp/gt-flight-03.tar.gz https://huggingface.co/datasets/miguelemosreverte/alambique-datasets/resolve/main/scenes/kazbek-run-c10-gt/gt-flight-03.tar.gz && tar xzf /tmp/gt-flight-03.tar.gz -C /workspace/gt && rm /tmp/gt-flight-03.tar.gz

cd /workspace/gsplat && GT_DEPTH_DIR=/workspace/gt python3 examples/simple_trainer.py default \
  --data-dir /workspace/scenes/kazbek-run-c10 --data-factor 1 \
  --result-dir /workspace/results/gsplat_kazbek-run-nc-mip \
  --max-steps 100000 --eval-steps 100000 \
  --strategy.refine-stop-iter 75000 --strategy.grow-grad2d 0.00005 --strategy.prune-opa 0.002 \
  --opacity-reg 0.0005 --scale-reg 0.01 --depth-loss --depth-lambda 0.01 --antialiased --disable-viewer
